exposure: indication for previous cesarean delivery (arrest of dilation or descent)
cohort: Participants were individuals delivered on or after 37 0/7 weeks' gestation with a live singleton cephalic fetus, who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean delivery, and had a history of one previous low-transverse cesarean delivery.
finding: An accurate prediction model for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) was derived, indicating that VBAC was more likely for taller women and those with a previous vaginal birth, and less likely for older women, heavier women, those with a previous cesarean for arrest of dilation/descent, and those with chronic hypertension.
